title: Your first shift at Harbor & Pine

data.headline: Your first shift, made simple
data.kicker: Three habits that make every shift easier.

beats.say: Welcome to your first shift at Harbor and Pine.
Here are three habits that make every shift easier.

steps.title: Greet in five seconds
steps.text: Eye contact and a hello, even when busy.

steps.title: Call the name
steps.text: Say it when the drink is ready.

steps.title: Wipe as you go
steps.text: A clean bar is a fast bar.

beats.say: First, greet every guest within five seconds, even when the line is long.
Second, call the guest's name when their drink is ready.
And third, wipe as you go. A clean bar is a fast bar.

data.try: Hi there, what can I get started for you?

beats.say: Small words matter. Instead of calling out next,
try: hi there, what can I get started for you?

data.label: Pro tip
data.tip: Stuck on an order? Ask your shift lead. Nobody expects you to know it all on day one.

beats.say: And if you get stuck on an order, ask your shift lead.
Nobody expects you to know it all on day one.

data.headline: Find your shift lead and say hello

beats.say: Now go find your shift lead and say hello. We're glad you're here.
